layout: LampCells (plan 01, 11.7): three float32 little-endian planes, sodiumLm, ledLm, otherLm, each ny rows of nx cells, row 0 = south, column 0 = west
frame: local metres of public/data/lv/terrain.json (x east, y north); world z = -y, so row j spans world z from z0 - j*step to z0 - (j+1)*step

excluded.why: under bridges (Clark County SUPP_TYPE UBL) or tunnel luminaires: they light the road and send nothing to the sky

source: scripts/build_lights.py; lamps from data/derived/lv/lamps.bin; see data/derived/lv/lights_report.json
credit: Street lights: Clark County Public Works, City of Las Vegas, City of Henderson (via its lighting contractor's public layer), Boulder City; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
